changeSet.author: derkach
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO lesson (module_id, title, content_url, order_index) SELECT m.id, 'Mock Lesson ' + CAST(v.value AS VARCHAR(10)), 'http://mock-url.com/lesson/' + CAST(v.value AS VARCHAR(10)), v.value FROM module m CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 10) v WHERE m.title LIKE 'Mock Module %';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM lesson WHERE title LIKE 'Mock Lesson %';
